title: Zen Bound
notes: Physical ARM64 smoke test on 2026-10-09, IPA SHA-256 631BFD730339DD8F9AB37FF3A404CC49A30C85CC5DA418267D102D98B72A3D0E. Headphone splash, tree menu, level selection and first wrapping scene render. A touch swipe changes the object and advances completion from 0% to 3%. Full-level progression, audio, saves and sustained performance were not tested.

reviewedUserReports.notes: POCO M2007J20CG (Android 12, ARM64/Adreno 618), Super Duper Release f8d2fecb. Exact IPA SHA-256 verified. Cold launch opens the Tree of Reflection menu, selects Humility and reaches the first 3D string-wrapping level. Swipes rotate the wooden object, string use changes, and completion increased from 0% to 3% on this Release retest. This confirms first-level rendering and touch interaction, not completion of the level or whole game. Acoustic audio, ordinary save/reload, later levels, long-session stability and other device profiles remain unverified.
